newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU rice officials set peripheral aid rates.
newsitem.headline: EU rice officials set peripheral aid rates.

text.p: BRUSSELS, Nov 29 (Brussels) - European Union rice officials on Thursday fixed new aid rates for supplies to peripheral regions, an EU official said on Friday.
"The aid for white rice to the Canaries, the Azores and Madeira was set at 261 Ecus per tonne and for broken rice to the Canaries at 57 Ecus per tonne", the offcial said.
Discussion on aid for the supply of rice to so-called Poseidom countries and on compensatory aid for rice producers was deferred, the offcial added.
